Disputes: (1) consensus level $202.1B vs $205.65B: an aggregator difference I couldn't settle without web access; I weight $202.1B as more widely cited. (2) Q1'26 beat size (+3.0B) is partly unverified memory; it doesn't change the median of beats much. (3) Median $203.1-204.0B is a judgment on beat size; I take the historical median beat (~$1.2B) over $202B, giving $203.2B, with a slightly wider left tail because the FX path since July is unchecked. I carried forward Run 3's dispersion approach. I retrieved no sources on this run.
